title: How to Head Swap a Photo With AI (Free, No App Needed)

body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**To head swap a photo, open**


[Magic Hour Head Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/head-swap) **, upload the base photo, upload the replacement head photo and click Swap Heads.**


The current guest tool offers **three free head swaps per day, no signup and no watermark**


. Use photos with similar head angles and lighting, then check the hairline, ears and neck before downloading.


A head swap is useful when you want the replacement person's hair and head shape as well as their face. If you want to keep the original hairstyle, start with a face swap instead.

### Try a head swap with two clear photos


Upload the base scene and replacement head, then inspect the hairline, head shape, lighting, and background before downloading.


[Try Head Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/head-swap)


## What you need


- **A base photo:** the body, pose and scene you want to keep.
- **A head photo:** a clear view of the head you want to add, including the hair you want to preserve.
- **Similar perspective:** try to match head direction, camera height and lighting between the two photos.
- **Permission to use the inputs:** particularly for another person's likeness or commercial work.


PNG, JPG/JPEG and WebP are supported. You can use the guest tool in a desktop or phone browser; creating an account is optional for this workflow.


## How to head swap a photo, step by step


### 1. Open the Head Swap tool


Go directly to[Head Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/head-swap) . You do not need to search through the dashboard or install an app.


### 2. Upload the base photo


Choose **Upload base photo** . This is the image whose head will be replaced. For example, if you want a new head on a person wearing a jacket, upload the jacket photo here.


Use a photo where the head and shoulders are visible. Leave room around the hair so the edit is not forced against the edge of the image.


### 3. Upload the replacement head photo


Choose **Upload head photo** . This image supplies the new head. A sharp portrait at a similar angle gives the model clearer information than a distant, blurred or heavily filtered face.


If the base person is looking slightly left, start with a reference looking in a similar direction. A front-facing portrait may be a poor match for a full side profile.


### 4. Click Swap Heads


Confirm that the two photos are in the correct positions, then click **Swap Heads** . Wait for the result before submitting another attempt. Processing time can vary; there is no need to repeatedly click while the first request is running.


The account-based[Head Swap workspace](https://magichour.ai/create/head-swap) can show different controls and a credit estimate. Its balance is separate from the guest tool's daily allowance.


### 5. Review and download


Look at the full image and a closer view of the head. Check the neck join, ears, hair edges, head size and lighting. Also compare the body, clothing and background with the original. Download the result when it meets your needs.

## Fix an unnatural head swap


Problem


Likely issue


What to try next


The head looks too large or small


Different camera distances or proportions


Choose inputs with more similar framing


A visible seam appears at the neck


Mismatched pose, skin tone or lighting


Use a reference with similar head tilt and light direction


Hair looks cut off or blurred


Cropped hair, compression or unclear edges


Use the original high-quality photo with space around the head


The face no longer resembles the reference


Weak facial detail or a difficult angle


Try a sharper, less obstructed reference


The wrong person changes in a group


The intended target is ambiguous


Use a workflow with explicit person selection or a dedicated multi-face tool


The outfit or background changes


The edit extends beyond the intended region


Compare against the original; use a tighter editing workflow for details that must stay exact


Change one input at a time so you can tell whether the new reference helped. Upscaling a flawed result will not reliably repair identity or replace missing source detail.


## Other browser tools to consider


The current search results include both head-swap and face-swap tools, so check what each actually changes:


- [Facy Head Swap](https://facy.ai/photo-head-swap) **:** offers a full-head workflow with free credits after signup. Its paid HeadUltra model adds prompt-based selection of a particular person in a group photo.
- [Pixlr Face Swap](https://pixlr.com/face-swap/) **:** offers a face-photo and target-photo workflow with PNG download. It is described as face swapping; do not assume that means it transfers the full hairstyle and head outline.


For a broader comparison of formats, free allowances and pricing, see our[face-swap app guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/best-face-swap-app) .


## What to do after the swap


If the still image needs a small cleanup, use the[AI Image Editor](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-editor) with a specific instruction about the edge or background you want to change. Recheck the face after any further edit.


To add motion, use[Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/products/image-to-video) . To make the portrait speak, use[Talking Photo](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-talking-photo) with the audio you want it to follow. Choose the next step based on the output you need.
